decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those shown on the drawings hereby approved.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Application Form, Design and Access Statement, GPR/01, GPR/05-, GPR/10-A, GPR/11-, Received 16 August 2012, GPR/50, Received 8 October 2012, GPR/20-C, Received 11 October 2012, therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The main ridge capping shall be maintained at the junction of the extension and the existing roof ridge height.

Condition : 5 - The window in the north-western side elevation of the dwelling at 65 Grove Park Road at ground floor level shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 6 - The rooflight on the roof of the extension at 65 Grove Park Road shall be flush, and shall not project above the roof ridge line.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extensions hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - The window in the south-eastern side elevation of the dwelling at 63 Grove Park Road at first floor level shall be obscure glazed and fixed, and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a two storey rear extension across the width of two houses, erection of a rear roof extension to no. 65 and installation of solar panels to two roof slopes.
